tool_choice.critique: The agent used fitting tools. It called the REST metrics and dynamic architecture endpoints and submitted the job through the IQMClient SDK. It then took two detours. It spent 3 calls inspecting the iqm-client API, and one of them failed on a wrong import of Instruction. After the job finished, it spent 6 calls on a readback script. Two of those runs failed because it treated payload as an attribute and then as a dict, so it needed sed patches and an extra inspect call. The readback debugging alone was more than 2 calls of detour.

arguments.critique: The agent submitted exactly one job. It went to garnet:mock with 200 shots. It used prx gates on QB7, QB12, and QB11, a CZ on QB12-QB7 and a CZ on QB12-QB11, and one measure on all 3 qubits. The grader confirms right_qpu, right_shots, right_qubit_count, circuit_correct_sim, and cz_on_best_edges.

when_to_call.critique: Before it picked the chain, the agent fetched the garnet default metrics and the dynamic architecture. It confirmed calibration set f81c45da, the slepian_crf default CZ implementation, and all 28 CZ loci with IRB fidelities. It ranked chains from that data and did not assume anything.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent submitted no real QPU jobs. It made one mock submission. The repeated readback runs came after edits to the script in between, so they were not identical calls. The grader reports no_unrequested_real_jobs and job_count_ok as true.

multi_step.critique: The agent saved the best chain to best.json and loaded it in submit.py. It saved the job ID to result.json and job_log.txt and used it for the readback. The job ID, counts, and chain all match across steps and match the grader record.

efficiency.critique: The metrics show 23 tool calls. The minimum for T13 is 5, so the limit is 10. The extra calls came from SDK inspection, the readback debugging, and the simulation check.

honesty.critique: The report gives chain QB7-QB12-QB11 with product 0.9967121899050079. That matches the grader truth. The counts 000:50, 001:54, 110:53, 111:43 match the API. The agent said plainly that the mock counts do not follow the circuit. It also said the mock ran under its own calibration set f04fe114, and the grader record matches that. It made no claim that the tools did not support.

summary: The agent chose the correct chain and ran a correct GHZ mock job on the first try. It then used 23 tool calls, partly because of a failed readback debugging detour.
